subject: AutumnLake contract questions — need senior authorization on risk changes
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@autumnlake.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood platform contract redlines + pricing request

Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. We've reviewed the draft SOW and standard terms and attached our redlines (AutumnLake_redlines_v2.docx). A few high-level asks:

- Increase liability cap to $2.5M (our procurement policy requires liability to be >1x anticipated spend).
- Broaden indemnity to cover third-party claims related to data processing (we host patient-adjacent datasets).
- Extend warranty survival from 90 to 180 days and add an uptime credit clause for outages >8 hours.
- We are asking for a 20% TCV discount for a 24-month commitment.

We'd like to get legal and procurement aligned this week. Can you route for approvals and come back with what you can accept?

Bootstrapping timeline: procurement needs signed agreement by Dec 15 to make this quarter.

Attachments: AutumnLake_redlines_v2.docx

Best,
Ethan Cole
Director of Platform Partnerships
AutumnLake Therapeutics

Subject: Fwd: Redwood platform contract redlines + pricing request — need senior review

Team — forwarding AutumnLake's redlines and asks. Quick summary and suggested decision points:

Summary of customer asks (attached):
- Liability cap -> $2.5M (currently standard is $500k / 1x ARR floor).
- Indemnity expanded to include third-party data processing claims (they cite patient-adjacent data).
- Warranty survival 180 days + outage credit ask.
- 20% TCV discount for 24-month term.

Why this matters: AutumnLake is a strategic early adopter in therapeutics; ARR ~ $420k first year with healthy expansion potential. Getting them on a 24-month commitment materially influences our Q4 ARR targets.

What I need:
1) Legal confirmation on whether we can accept the indemnity language or propose carveouts (laura).
2) Deal desk recommendation on acceptable liability cap and discount (dev).
3) Markus — asking for senior OK on any increase above $1M and on a final discount cap. If you approve, I'll send a firm counter and a redlined Doc.

Attachments: AutumnLake_redlines_v2.docx

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0188
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood platform contract redlines + pricing request — need senior review

Thanks Naomi — read the redlines. My recommended disposition:

- Liability cap: we should avoid $2.5M. Recommend cap of $1.5M (approx 3.5x 1st-year ARR) as a one-time concession for strategic wins, with standard renewal revert. This gives procurement a meaningful figure while limiting our exposure.
- Indemnity: cannot broadly indemnify for all third-party data processing claims. Recommend we accept indemnity for IP infringement and claims arising from our willful misconduct, but carve out claims related to customer's data practices unless we expressly control those processes. For patient-adjacent data, propose additional DPA language and joint responsibility clauses.
- Warranty: willing to extend survival to 120 days (from 90), not 180. For uptime credits, accept a modest SLA credit (service credit caps linked to monthly fees) but not broad remedies.
- Discount: 20% is above our typical maximum for this segment. Recommend 15% TCV discount for 24-month; tie to prepayment or revenue commitment milestones.

I can produce a redline (attached: redwood-response-redline_20271207.docx) and a suggested carrier of the liability number into the SOW. If Markus gives the go-ahead on $1.5M & 15% discount, we can finalize and send to AutumnLake procurement.

--
Dev Patel
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood platform contract redlines + pricing request — need senior review

Thanks for the clear recommendation. I approve proceeding on the following conditional concessions:

- Liability cap: APPROVED up to $1.5M one-time for this deal only (documented in Deal Notes; revert to standard on renewal).
- Indemnity: APPROVED limited indemnity to IP claims and willful misconduct only. Customer-responsibility carveout for data handling retained. Laura, please ensure our draft language explicitly calls out the carveout.
- Warranty: APPROVED extension to 120 days and a capped SLA credit for prolonged outages (caps to be defined by legal/ops).
- Discount: APPROVED up to 15% TCV, subject to prepayment or milestone structure. Finance to confirm revenue recognition implications before countersignature.

Naomi — proceed with Dev's redline and send the updated package to AutumnLake procurement. Laura, loop in finance if the prepayment changes S/W recognition. If procurement pushes back on $1.5M, escalate to me immediately.

Markus Klein
Chief Commercial Officer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@autumnlake.com>, procurement@autumnlake.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood platform contract redlines + pricing request

Ethan — thanks for sending your team's redlines. We reviewed internally with Legal and Deal Desk and have an executive decision on the key items you asked about. Summary of what we can accept: 

- Liability cap: $1,500,000 (one-time concession for this 24-month agreement).
- Indemnity: limited to IP infringement and willful misconduct. We cannot accept general indemnity for customer data processing; instead, we've proposed strengthened DPA language and joint responsibilities for data handling in the redline.
- Warranty: survival period extended to 120 days and we will include a limited SLA credit structure for outages >8 hours (caps included in redline).
- Pricing: we can offer 15% TCV discount for a 24-month term, conditional on upfront payment of year 1.

I've attached our counter redline (redwood-response-redline_20271207.docx) and a clean SOW (AutumnLake_SOW_v3.pdf). If those are acceptable, we'll prepare the DocuSign packet for signature. Please confirm by EOD Thursday (Dec 9) if you want to proceed to countersignature so we can meet your procurement timeline.

Attachments: redwood-response-redline_20271207.docx; AutumnLake_SOW_v3.pdf

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
